stories.title: Russian drone and missile attacks kill three in Kyiv overnight, injury toll rises to seven
stories.reason: Two women aged 46 and 95 died when a drone hit a private home and a Kyivteploenergo worker was killed at a warehouse strike in the Solomianskyi district, with a cafe also set ablaze, as Russia's multi-day bombardment of the capital continued into a new night.

stories.title: Trump unveils $200 billion South Korean investment package, including $54 billion for an Alaska gas pipeline
stories.reason: The Oval Office announcement covers the Alaska LNG pipeline plus a Texas gas-fired power plant and eight nuclear reactors, marking the first major projects under Seoul's broader $350 billion strategic investment pledge, though South Korean lawmakers have questioned its financing and commercial viability.

stories.title: Iran confirms it has received a formal US response to its seven-day Hormuz ceasefire proposal
stories.reason: Foreign Minister Araghchi presented the American reply, relayed through Qatari mediators, to President Pezeshkian, but Tehran has disclosed no details; the two sides remain divided over the sequencing of a deal after Trump had publicly rejected Iran's original offer.

stories.title: US Q2 GDP growth revised sharply higher to 2.2%, up from an initial 1.5% estimate
stories.reason: The Bureau of Economic Analysis's third estimate reflected stronger consumer spending, business investment and exports than previously measured, while core PCE inflation for the quarter was revised down to 3.3%, giving a mixed read heading into Friday's jobs report.

stories.title: Australia's central bank raises its cash rate to 4.6%, the highest level in nearly 15 years
stories.reason: The Reserve Bank's board voted unanimously for its fourth hike of 2026, citing above-target 3.5% inflation driven partly by AI-related demand for technology goods and energy, and signaled further increases are possible.

stories.title: Israeli strikes kill at least seven people in Gaza, including a journalist, as ceasefire violations continue
stories.reason: Separate strikes hit an apartment and a vehicle in Gaza City and killed journalist Mohammed Abdul Aziz al-Najjar near Khan Younis, the 263rd reporter killed in the territory since October 2023, underscoring continued violence despite the broader ceasefire framework.

stories.title: China imposes an additional 55% tariff on Brazilian beef after imports hit their annual quota
stories.reason: The surtax takes total duties on over-quota shipments to 67% and comes after Beijing rebuffed a bid by Brazil to borrow unused quota from Uruguay, squeezing the Brazilian cattle industry's biggest export market.

stories.title: Amazon, Google, Meta, Microsoft, OpenAI and others pledge to help cover power costs near AI data centers
stories.reason: The White House-brokered 'Ratepayer Protection Pledge' has major AI firms voluntarily committing to shield local residents from rising electricity bills, arriving as more than 1,000 US communities have imposed moratoriums or restrictions on new data centers.
